title: state-pairs.json - factual unprocessed/processed pairings
description: FACTUAL data only. That Raw trout cooks into Trout is game data. That a foil on one unlocks the other is a ruling and lives in rules.json.

label.description: Human readable name for the item, not for either state. 'Trout', not 'Raw trout'.

kind.description: The transformation that links the two states. Conventional values: cook, clean, tan, smelt, spin, string, grind. Add a value only when the game supports it.

states.description: Exactly two. A three-state chain is a schema error on purpose - it needs a recorded decision, not a silent extension.
